name: Monta Utility
brief: Cleanup utilities for Business Central tenants, starting with residual Additional Reporting Currency amounts on G/L Entry.
description: Monta Utility ships administrative cleanup routines for Business Central. The first routine is a processing report that blanks the three Additional Reporting Currency fields on G/L Entry ("Additional-Currency Amount", "Add.-Currency Debit Amount", "Add.-Currency Credit Amount") left behind when Additional Reporting Currency was configured on a tenant by mistake and later removed. Access is gated by the shipped "Monta GL Cleanup" permission set; every run is logged to telemetry (UserId, filters applied, row count).
